text: Cloth armour with a boon woven into every piece, and as tough as diamond. It spends a little Pulse from a Pulse Cell you carry to keep those boons going.
pages.title: Spiritweave armour
The cloth
text: Spiritweave cloth comes from **Echo Bind** with the Water voice: any wool becomes one cloth, and Echo Silk, Dawn Velvet, Lantern Down, Mossback Scale or a Storm Wing becomes two.
Four pieces take the usual armour shapes; the robe and leggings also take a Resonant Core in the middle. Spiritweave cloth mends them on any anvil. Echo Unweave turns cloth back into wool.

pages.title: Wearing it
text: Unlinked, each piece has its own boon:
- **Boots**: slow falling whenever you drop more than a block.

Hood, robe and leggings spend **2 Pulse every four seconds**, and that keeps every perk of the piece going, the ones that answer a blow, a fall or a snare as well as the steady boons. The boots spend only when they catch you, and not while Slow Falling is already on you; each payment covers four seconds.
When your cells run dry the boons stop, every perk with them. Recharge, or take the pieces off.

pages.title: Voices and ranks
text: Crouch-use a piece on a placed Resonance Totem with **40 Pulse** in a carried cell, and the totem's voice replaces the default boon. A bound piece spends **3 Pulse** instead of 2. Mixed voices are intended; see [Totem-bound gear](totem_bound_gear).

Rank each piece in Echo Attune, Bind and Manifest, with the same costs and catalysts as [Spiritgear](spiritgear). Every rank makes a piece sturdier: more armour and toughness, more knockback resistance, and extra health, up to **2 hearts** a piece at Manifested.

pages.title: Full sets
text: Wear a whole set of one rank and it works together:
- A full **Bound** set: **10%** less damage taken.

- A full **Manifested** set: about **29 armour** and **20 toughness**, **8 extra hearts**, **20%** less damage taken, and, while the robe is switched on, it mends a heart every four seconds for **4 Pulse**. Built for the hardest fights.

pages.title: A cell of its own
text: Like [Spiritgear](spiritgear), every piece can carry a **Pulse Cell** of its own: right-click a cell onto the piece in your inventory and it goes inside, charge and all. The piece spends from that cell before it touches the cells you carry. Right-click the piece with an empty cursor to take the cell back out.
On a hood with goggles, once the cell is out, the next empty-cursor click takes the goggles off and gives you back the Ley Lens they were made from.

pages.title: Switching a piece off
text: Every worn piece has an off switch. Open the Gear screen (the apostrophe key by default, under Tribal Power in Controls) and set the piece to Off: it still protects like armour, but every perk of the piece stops, the ones that answer a blow or a fall too, and it draws no Pulse until you switch it back. The tooltip says so in red while it is off.
The hood's goggles have their own switch there, and their own key. The same screen shows which vault your satchel opens and lets you hide the Pulse HUD.
